title: Auto-tune downstream circuit & pool thresholds using shadow traffic + chaos
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Problem: We currently set circuit breaker failure thresholds and connection pool sizes via conservative static heuristics. This leads to either overaggressive shedding (higher user error rates and wasted throughput) or late tripping (long tails and SLO breaches) when downstream stores (Redis/Kafka/Primary DB) saturate or change characteristics across regions.

Goal: Build a safe, observability-driven system that uses shadowed production traffic + controlled chaos experiments to automatically recommend and (optionally) apply tuned circuit breaker thresholds, connection-pool reservations, and per-tenant soft-shed probabilities that minimize SLO violations while maximizing throughput and safety across regions.
acceptance_criteria: A1: End-to-end pipeline exists to shadow ~1-5% of production traffic to a non-impacting path instrumented for failure injection.
A2: Automatic tuning job produces recommended thresholds (failure rate, latency p95, concurrent-conns) and quantifies expected SLO delta with a 95% CI.
A3: Recommendations can be previewed in Console with diffs and simulated rollout metrics before any automatic change.
A4: Safe-rollout mechanism: automated canary of recommended thresholds to <0.5% traffic, abort on predefined SLO regressions within 5 minutes.
A5: Playbook and runbook added to Console (links below) describing emergency rollback, and human approval gating for tenant-impacting changes.
A6: Smoke tests validating no regression in host-level latency or error budget consumption in two test regions and one multi-tenant demo cluster.
implementation_plan: Step 1: Instrument a shadowing proxy to duplicate requests into a tunable test pipeline which mirrors production headers (tenant, route) but returns discarded responses.
Step 2: Add failure-injection hooks (latency, TCP resets, partial errors) for Redis/Kafka/DB in shadow pipeline implemented as a chaos stage.
Step 3: Create a tuning worker that runs experiments (grid + Bayesian) over candidate CB thresholds, pool sizes, and probabilistic-shed rates using shadowed results and computes expected SLO impact.
Step 4: Expose recommendations through Console with a compare view and metric projections (token cost, p99 latency, error-budget burn).
Step 5: Implement safe-apply: canary rollout + automatic rollback if SLO regression or error-rate spike is detected.
Step 6: Document playbook, add alerts and dashboards, and schedule ops runbook training.
observability_requirements: Per-request trace id propagation from shadow pipeline into dashboards
Duration distributions (p50/p90/p95/p99) for successful and failed calls in shadow versus prod
Failure mode breakdown (connect, timeout, application error, partial response) in shadow experiments
Estimated error-budget delta projection for each recommended setting
Audit log for all recommended and applied threshold changes
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (internal): Run experiments using 1% shadow traffic in staging cluster for 2 weeks; validate tuning job stability.
Phase 1 (pilot): Shadow 2 regions with 0.5-1% of production traffic for 1 week; surface recommendations in Console (manual apply only).
Phase 2 (canary-apply): Automated canary apply to 0.5% traffic with 10-minute observation window and abort on SLO regressions >10% of weekly burn rate.
Phase 3 (opt-in): Allow selected Dedicated customers to opt-in to auto-tune in their region with explicit consent and audit trail.
Phase 4 (gradual): If pilot metrics are stable after 4 weeks, expand default opt-in for new clusters with opt-out available.
testing_plan: Unit tests for tuning worker (simulation harness + deterministic seeds)
Integration tests that replay recorded production traces through the shadow+chaos pipeline
Load tests to ensure shadowing does not increase tail latency on the primary path
Chaos experiments controlled by feature-flag: validate tuning job converges under a set of adverse downstream patterns
E2E smoke: canary apply + auto-rollback exercised in pre-prod with injected SLO breaches
